parts.name: 1.50” X 1.50” Fiber Reinforced Polyurethane T-slotted Profile - Four Open T-slots
parts.description: 1.50” x 1.50” 15 series T-slotted profile with four open T-slots made from Fiber Reinforced Polyurethane (FRP), black, in a 120” stock length; electrically and thermally non-conductive and corrosion-resistant.
features: 15 Series Profile made from high-strength Fiber Reinforced Polyurethane (FRP) consisting of 80% fiberglass and 20% polyurethane resin.
Key benefits: Electrically non-conductive, thermally non-conductive, and corrosion-resistant
Typical applications: EMI/RFI-sensitive environments, data center racks and enclosures, automotive battery facilities, and marine & shipyard installations

specs.Hardness: For the 4800 neat the Shore D Hardness has been measured between 78-80
specs.Twist: 1° per foot of length, total twist not to exceed 7°
